text: Move through the orchard with W/A/S/D.
Click the orchard to engage it, then look around with the mouse.
Hold Shift while moving to sprint.
Left-click a tree to select it.
Move around the selected tree with W/A/S/D.
Press Backspace to return to free flight.
Press 1 to expose and cycle the tools, select Sprout Spawner, then right-click clear ground to plant two more blank sprouts. Crowded placements are refused.
Press Tab to open the ledger, choose Tools > Available, and acquire Double Cut.
Acquiring Double Cut equips it. If you need to change tools, press 1 to expose and cycle them. Left-click a tree, then right-click a branch to add two nested cuts.
Press Tab to reopen the ledger after the Double Cut explanation so Iteration becomes available.
In the ledger, choose Tools > Available and acquire Iteration.

Acquiring Iteration equips it. If you need to change tools, press 1 to expose and cycle them. Right-click a nonblank tree to hold a cutting, then right-click clear ground to duplicate it. Press Backspace to release a held cutting.
On the tree with Double Cut, right-click one of the gray branches created by the cut to hold that branch. Then right-click the root segment of the same tree to iterate a copy there.
Open Orders > Available and accept the blank-sprout order. Use Iteration and right-click a blank sprout to take it, then right-click that order's pot to deliver it.
